note: 30 episodes, 3 simulated lines each, ground-truth scored, no judge model.
reading: The sensor+filter loop infers a hidden mode at 3x chance. It TIES the honest single-shot LLM baseline (0.60), so on a 3-line task the filter buys persistence/state, not extra accuracy. Note the honest baseline is 0.60, NOT chance (0.20) -- reporting chance as the baseline would inflate any apparent loop gain.
